messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated token_error rate and p99 latency spike observed in Dedicated pool orchid-07 affecting tenant 'LumiCorp' (VPC: lumi-vpc-prod). Severity P1. Auto-paging oncall.
oncall_omar: oncall acked. Paging SRE and runtime. Im grabbing the runbook now.
sre_maya: seeing ~6x increase in token_err and a big p99 jump confined to orchid-07. Tenants other than LumiCorp not showing same pattern. Initial hypothesis: tenant-specific workload producing long-context fusion requests.
eng-runtime-raj: adding context: we deployed q5-beta quant path to orchid-07 last night. It added an optimized attention kernel that might behave badly for >4k sequences. Will look at kernel telemetry.
oncall_omar: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle LumiCorp to 50rps 2) create per-tenant isolation slot and migrate them off orchid-07 3) disable q5-beta on the affected shard. Proceeding with 1 & 2.
deploy-bot: Suggested command:
```
redwoodctl reserve-slot --pool orchid-07 --tenant LumiCorp --slot-name lumi-isol-1
redwoodctl route-tenant --tenant LumiCorp --to-pool orchid-standby-02 --mode live
```
oncall_omar: executing reservation + routing. ETA ~75s. Will monitor for error rate drop.
eng-runtime-raj: added a temporary KV cache bypass and disabled prefix caching for LumiCorp during migration to avoid cache eviction storm.
sre_maya: token_err rate dropped from 4.7% to 0.4% after migration. p99 improved but still higher than baseline by ~30ms. Collecting traces across 09:10-09:25 window.
custsuccess_lee: I'm on a bridge with LumiCorp's ops. They're seeing degraded latency in production and may have customer calls. Giving them a short note now.
oncall_omar: drafting customer status:
> Hi LumiCorp team, were investigating an incident impacting your dedicated pool. We have temporarily isolated your traffic to a standby pool and applied rate limits to stabilize. We're collecting data and will send a detailed timeline within 60 minutes. Omar, Redwood Oncall
acct_exec_julie: they are on an enterprise reserved contract. Please flag potential SLA credit and prepare an exec summary. Ill loop in LumiCorps account owner.
legal_sam: ack. Do not promise credits yet; wait for verified impact window. Ill stand by to review customer-facing language.
eng-runtime-raj: log excerpt for thread:
```
[2026-06-02T09:12:03Z] tenant=LumiCorp seq_len=8196 kv_cache_evictions=1800 token_err=502
[2026-06-02T09:12:04Z] dispatch_ms=1380 p99=1560ms inflight=890
```
sre_maya: correlating with host metrics: CPU steal and L3-miss rate spiked at same time on shard 3 of orchid-07. Looks like kernel path q5-beta triggers poor cache behavior for certain packed attention sizes.
eng-runtime-raj: running quick rollback of q5-beta on shard 3. If stable, plan a pool-wide rollback and re-evaluate canary gates.
oncall_omar: status update: LumiCorp traffic on orchard-standby-02 (isolated), token_err ~0.2%, p99 nearly baseline. Preparing RCA artifacts.
pm_jordan: (pm_jordan) typo - correcting channel: PM here. I will export deployment timeline and canary progression for RCA.
acct_exec_julie: drafting exec note to leadership:
> LumiCorp P1 incident: long-sequence requests triggered a regression in a new quant kernel (q5-beta) deployed to orchid-07. We isolated the tenant and rolled back the kernel on affected shards. Service restored to baseline within ~18 minutes. Investigating full rollback plan and SLA impact.
legal_sam: reviewed customer-facing draft; remove any specific credit amounts from initial comms. We'll calculate credits after full impact window is confirmed.
sre_maya: perf capture completed. Summary: L3-miss ratio increased 4.2x and context-switch rate up correlating with seq_len>6k. Eviction storms caused repeated KV fetches stalling GPU dispatch.
eng-runtime-raj: rollback verified on canary shard; L3 misses down ~65%. Were scheduling a full rollback during low-traffic window unless QA objects.
oncall_omar: RCA draft snippet for customer:
> What happened: On 2026-06-02 09:10 UTC, LumiCorp experienced elevated latency and token errors caused by an interaction between long-sequence production requests and q5-beta quantization kernel deployed to orchid-07. Immediate actions: we routed traffic to an isolated standby pool and rolled back q5-beta on affected shards. Impact window: ~09:1009:28 UTC. No customer data accessed beyond normal inference requests. Next steps: remove q5-beta from orchid-07, add longer-sequence regression tests to the canary suite, and strengthen rollout gating (seq_len cap, telemetry thresholds) for quant kernels.
custsuccess_lee: customer confirmed traffic normalized and asked for a short executive summary to share with their CTO. They also requested a technical session next week to review mitigations.
acct_exec_julie: Ill prepare a credits estimate after SRE provides exact impacted token counts. Also prepping leadership summary.
legal_sam: noting potential contract clause triggers; Ill coordinate with finance to calculate any owed credits once impact is finalized.
pm_jordan: follow-up actions I've logged: 1) full rollback schedule 2) expand kernel canary tests 3) telemetry alerts for seq_len and cache-eviction thresholds 4) customer webinar scheduling.
deploy-bot: runbook watcher: set incident-watch for 3 hours and create task items in tracker #INC-2026-142.
sre_maya: closing the immediate page; will keep thread open for RCA attachments and customer comms signoff. Reopen if regressions appear.
oncall_omar: thanks all. tagging owners: raj -> runtime follow-through, maya -> perf analysis & final token impact, lee -> customer comms, julie -> exec liaison, sam -> legal signoff. :white_check_mark:
